dedupe_keys.name: global altimeter wave height and wind speed 1985 2018

description: Ribal and Young publish calibrated global significant-wave-height and wind-speed observations from 13 satellite altimeters. The own Australian Ocean Data Network catalogue XML identifies the corrected 1985–2018 release, NetCDF files and CC BY 4.0 terms. Individual measurements retain latitude and longitude while files are grouped into one-degree geographic bins. Coastal and maritime modellers can compare storm-wave forcing or offshore design scenarios with this satellite-derived record. A caveat is that an altimeter track samples the sea intermittently and does not replace continuous nearshore wave measurements. The own metadata says an earlier release had erroneous wind-speed values that were corrected in this version, so its DOI must be kept distinct. Areas over land, ice or without overpasses have no files. I read the catalogue XML, registry DOI and article Data Records without downloading NetCDFs or testing calibration against buoys. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
